name: Kirei na Kokoro ga Aru Naraba
original_name: 綺麗な心があるならば
source:
The bullied Hakua is saved from bullies by Yuuto.
The bullies got revenge and trapped them in the gym storage room.
Help the two of them escape!

However, the seemingly pure Yuuto harbored dark feelings...?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ252894.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
受霸凌的Hakua被Yuuto从霸凌者手中救下。
霸凌者随后报复，把两人关进体育馆的器材室。
帮他们逃出去吧！

然而，看似纯真的Yuuto，心底却藏着黑暗的念头…？

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ252894.html]DLsite English[/url]]
